correctness.rationale: The marking is geometric and fixed. In the even-subset model, a nonzero isotropic class is a complementary pair of four-sets. Adding this class to the odd theta characteristic of an octad pair preserves odd parity exactly when that pair lies in one of the two blocks. This is exactly membership in the Steiner complex, so the map is the 28-by-35 internal-edge incidence (not the crossing incidence). I inspected the frozen verification and elementary-operation logic and reproduced the Smith form with a fresh matrix and exact integer Smith algorithm, without replaying the uploaded program. Every column has weighted degree three at each octad label. The seven degree differences are independent, their kernel is saturated, and the Smith rank is 21, so their kernel is exactly the saturation. The Smith factors give seven free directions, torsion index 49152 and exponent 6; a degree-one perfect matching witnesses the obstruction modulo three. This does not assert quartic divisor-class or Galois-module information.

value.rationale: Choosing an even theta characteristic naturally selects the 35 Steiner complexes, rather than an arbitrary matrix slice. Their exact integral span answers which formal bitangent weights can be reconstructed from these generators: equal degrees are the only rational constraints, and six is the least uniform multiplier. This is specific integral information useful for marked incidence questions and absent from the full-63 reconstruction invariant.
